The '''High Security Section''' was a district of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] complex on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was primarily used to contain criminals of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and [[Project Noble Focus]] performed most of its research on the High Security Section's inmates.

Around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.4}}</ref> during the [[Third Galactic War]], [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] searched the area for the [[HK-24 series assassin droid]] [[Shebs]].<ref name="TOR:TMH">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Memory Heist|Belsavis}}</ref>
